premium.basis: 63% over the last closing price (stated in Rationale section)

value_inflection_events.event: Positive interim results from the Phase 3 BEACON CRC trial (implied by stock move)

leaked_early.details: Rumors of a deal with Pfizer at ~$48 surfaced on June 14, 2019, just days before the official June 17 announcement, not 1+ month prior.

notes: The deal was catalyzed by the May 2019 BEACON CRC data, which drove a ~24% stock surge and prompted Pfizer's rapid, two-step bid increase from $44 to $48. Array had been exploring strategic options since 2017, with interest from multiple parties, but Pfizer's post-data offer and speed secured the deal.
